files.README.md:
# Quethiock Tickets - kiosk fleet

`flags/kiosk-flags.json` is the flag sheet for the ticket kiosks. Each entry carries the flag's enabled state and the percentage of kiosks it is rolled out to. A flag that is not on the sheet is not part of the kiosk build, and the sheet is the only place flags are set.

The kiosk team's runbook lives under `docs/`.
files.docs/kiosk-runbook.md:
# Kiosk runbook

Printed gift receipts are handled by the receipt printer's own menu on each machine, outside the flag sheet. Kiosks pick up flag changes on their overnight refresh, so a change made during the day reaches the floor the next morning.

turns.prompt: Quethiock Tickets' weekly pack reports how far each kiosk feature has reached, and this week's pack needs the figure for printed gift receipts. What percentage of kiosks is gift receipt printing rolled out to?
